topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes, reviews prior lecture concepts, and frames the session around the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Growth Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations across cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades, such as Wnt/beta-catenin and RTKs, drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how arrested terminal differentiation prevents cells from exiting the cell cycle across both hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how genetic alterations affecting p53 and the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins allow cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells overcome the Hayflick limit via telomerase reactivation and bypass normal p53-mediated senescence and stress responses.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Epigenetic Alterations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the shift toward aerobic glycolysis in cancer cells and how metabolic enzyme mutations produce oncometabolites that drive epigenetic deregulation.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the requirement for new blood vessel recruitment to supply growing tumors, including its early onset and regulatory control.

topics.label: Metastatic Dissemination and Colonisation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multi-step invasion-metastasis cascade, clinical methods for tracking disseminated tumor cells, and the genetic features of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Conclusion and Summary of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with summary reflections on hallmark integration, recommended literature, and logistical closing remarks.
